summary: Perspective Therapeutics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 1, 2026, solely to update its corporate presentation, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing contains no terms of acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC merger, activist campaign, strategic review, or abrupt management change. The presentation describes the company's next-generation radiopharmaceutical pipeline, including its VMT-α-NET and VMT01 programs, but does not announce any special-situation event. This routine current report updates investors with corporate progress without triggering a special-situation category.
